name: Hermes Memory
description: Scoped SQLite memory with ranked recall, a conservative curator, and human promotion.

cliCommands.name: memory
cliCommands.description: Inspect, approve, reject, and roll back Hermes memories

curatorModel.description: Optional provider/model for a future classifier. The default curator is deterministic and does not call a model.

dreaming.description: Hermes does not dream. The inherited loader reads dreaming.enabled from the memory slot owner's entry to decide whether to start memory-core as a dreaming sidecar; Paddy's default config sets it to false.

enabled.description: Start memory-core as a dreaming sidecar beside Hermes. Default config: false.
